code:
docker run -d --name neo4j \
  -p 7474:7474 -p 7687:7687 \
  -e NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/yourpassword \
  neo4j:latest

# 7474 = Neo4j Browser, 7687 = Bolt protocol
caption: NEO4J_AUTH sets credentials on first run — no default open instance.
